messages:
eva: thinking out loud: what if we attribute cache savings to fixed windows (30m or 1h) instead of the full session amortization? could smooth spikes in per-tenant previews.

noah: quick pros/cons?

eva: pros: stable previews, easier diffs in console, deterministic assignment. cons: need proration logic for shared cache and sampling for scale.

li: how to avoid double charge when cached responses serve multiple tenants?

eva: assign partition_key = hash(invocation_id)%256 for determinism; if multiple tenants hit same cached key in window, prorate by sampled hit shares.

jo: sampling for billing makes legal nervous. can we show confidence and fall back to conservative?

eva: yep. surface CI in console; if CI<0.75 mark as "estimate" and optionally round up. enterprise tenants can opt-out via feature flag.

noah: console wants a small "rolling window" mode in the cost panel and a diff slider (window vs prior window). also link to docs and show CI.

billingbot: action: run 7d sim, produce bias report, add feature flag toggle.

li: infra note: need router to emit route_id+sku so credits map to routing decisions. otherwise we might subsidize fallbacks.

eva: agreed. next steps: eva -> API proto, noah -> UX copy, li -> infra cost estimate, jo -> compliance check. quick sync Thurs?
